step1_analysis.description: A single gain stage of a broadband limiting amplifier. It features a cascaded differential pair (XM1-XM4), active feedback (XM5-XM6) for bandwidth extension, and cross-coupled transistors (XM7-XM8) acting as negative Miller capacitance to cancel parasitic capacitance.

paper_reference.title: 10-Gb/s Limiting Amplifier and Laser/Modulator Driver in 0.18-m CMOS Technology

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the single stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rload. With I_tail = 2mA, gm ~ 5-10 mS. Rload = 500 ohm. Gain ~ 2.5 to 5 V/V (8 to 14 dB) per stage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 50 dB for the entire limiting amplifier chain (likely 4-5 stages). A single stage is expected to provide 10-15 dB of gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * C_total). Without inductive peaking and using L=0.5um devices, parasitic capacitance is higher.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided netlist uses L=0.5um (slower than the paper's 0.18um) and lacks the inductive peaking mentioned in the paper. Bandwidth will be significantly lower, around 1-3 GHz.

power.description: DC power consumption of the single stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_total. I_total = I3 + I4 + I5 = 2mA + 2mA + 1mA = 5mA. Power = 1.8V * 5mA = 9mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the added ideal tail current sources required to bias the circuit for testing.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for internal stages

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing is limited by I_tail * Rload = 2mA * 500 ohm = 1V single-ended, or 2V differential maximum.
sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 0.2Vpp differential input and ~12dB gain, the output swing will be around 0.8Vpp differential.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, 3-dB bandwidth, and transient output swing of the limiting amplifier stage. Ideal load resistors and tail current sources are added to establish a valid DC operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Limiting Amplifier Stage
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVINp VINp 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG 0 0)
VVINn VINn 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG 180 0)

* Load resistors and tail current sources (added for biasing)
R1 VDD N1 500
R2 VDD N2 500
R3 VDD VOUTp 500
R4 VDD VOUTn 500
I3 N3 0 2m
I4 N4 0 2m
I5 N5 0 1m

* DUT
XM1 N1 VINp N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 VINn N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUTp N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUTn N2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 VOUTp N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 VOUTn N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N2 VINp GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 N1 VINn GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1MEG 100G
let vout_diff = v(VOUTp) - v(VOUTn)
let gain_db = vdb(vout_diff)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1MEG
let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 10p 20n
let vout_diff_tran = v(VOUTp) - v(VOUTn)
meas tran vout_max max vout_diff_tran from=10n to=20n
meas tran vout_min min vout_diff_tran from=10n to=20n
let vswing = vout_max - vout_min
print vswing

quit
.endc
